The corpus outlines key clinical guidelines and policies governing the management of atrial fibrillation, focusing on risk stratification for stroke prevention and the integration of structured patient education. 

Regarding pharmacological intervention, the guidelines rely on the [[CHA2DS2-VASc]] score to determine the necessity of [[antikoagulationsbehandling]] (anticoagulation treatment). For incident patients, a score of ≥2 serves as the clinical threshold for initiating treatment in both sexes. This specific cutoff is applied because the CHA2DS2-VASc calculation does not assign points for female sex [^src1]. This clinical policy regarding the sex-adjusted threshold is consistently reinforced across the 2023 and 2024 guideline updates [^src3].

Beyond pharmacological management, the guidelines strongly emphasize non-pharmacological support through [[Patientuddannelse]] (patient education). The 2024 [[ESC guidelines]] recommend patient education for individuals with atrial fibrillation and their relatives, establishing it as a central and integrated component of foundational treatment [^src2]. This modern approach aligns with the Danish National Clinical Guideline from 2019 ([[Sundhedsstyrelsen, 2019]]), which issues a strong recommendation that patients newly diagnosed with atrial fibrillation participate in cardiac rehabilitation programs that include patient education [^src2]. 

Together, these clinical guidelines outline a comprehensive standard of care that pairs precise, sex-adjusted risk scoring for stroke prevention with mandatory educational rehabilitation for patients and their families.

## Claims
- For incidente patienter anvendes ≥2 som skæringpunkt for indikation for antikoagulationsbehandling hos begge køn, da der ikke gives point for kvindekøn i CHA2DS2-VASc-beregningen [^src1] (cha2ds2-vasc, antikoagulationsbehandling)
  Type: clinical-guideline
  Page: 87
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2023.pdf, pages 86-90
- ESC-guidelines fra 2024 anbefaler patientuddannelse til patienter med atrieflimren og deres pårørende som en central og integreret del af grundlæggende behandling [^src2] (esc-guidelines, patientuddannelse)
  Type: clinical-guideline
  Page: 84
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2025.pdf, pages 81-85
- Den danske Nationale Kliniske Retningslinje fra 2019 giver en stærk anbefaling for, at patienter med ny atrieflimren-diagnose deltager i hjerterehabilitering indeholdende patientuddannelse [^src2] (sundhedsstyrelsen-2019, patientuddannelse)
  Type: clinical-guideline
  Page: 84
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2025.pdf, pages 81-85
- Der er ved beregningen af CHA2DS2-VASc score ikke givet point for kvindekøn, og ≥2 er derfor anvendt som skæringpunkt for indikation for antikoagulationsbehandling hos begge køn. [^src1] (cha2ds2-vasc, antikoagulationsbehandling)
